description: Look up the protocol's design convention for a kind of product: how firms already build it (its established form), the stock parts that form uses, and the checks a design of that kind must pass. Read-only: the description is matched and never stored. Entries are written only by Debbie, each naming her deb8 record; found=false means the protocol holds no convention for that kind yet, and you may send one with propose_design_convention.

product.description: A plain description of the product, e.g. its title and one line on what it does. Matched, then dropped: never stored.

name: look_up_design_convention
